errorTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errorBody: Your shop's data is safe. Start again to carry on.
mapLoadFailed: The map couldn't load (no internet?). Reload the page to try again.
photoFormat: This photo's format can't be used (often an iPhone or Samsung HEIC photo). Take it with Take photo, or pick a JPG.
locationOffBody: Customers find your salon by its location. Here's how to turn it on:
locationIosSettings: Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
locationIosServices: Tap Privacy & Security, then Location Services, and make sure it is on.
locationIosBrowser: Scroll down to Safari Websites (or your browser) and choose "While Using the App".
locationIosReturn: Come back here and reload the page, then tap Try again.
locationAndroidIcon: Tap the icon at the left of the address bar (a lock or two sliders).
locationAndroidAllow: Tap Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow.
locationAndroidQuickSettings: Check that Location is on in your phone’s quick settings (swipe down from the top).
locationAndroidReturn: Come back here and tap Try again.
locationDesktopIcon: Click the icon at the left of the address bar.
locationDesktopAllow: Find Location and set it to Allow.
locationDesktopReload: Reload the page and click Try again.
locationDesktopUsePhone: A computer can only guess where it is: register from your phone, standing in the salon.
mapMovableAria: Map: drag the pin to your salon's door, or tab to the pin and use the arrow keys
mapFixedAria: Map: your salon's pin, where customers find you
moreOffline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and tap {label} again.
moreNetwork: You're offline or the server can't be reached. Connect and tap {label} again.
moreFailed: Couldn't load more. Tap {label} to try again.
moreRefreshFailed: Couldn't refresh the list. It may be a little out of date.
